name: UMeWorld Inc.
summary: UMeWorld Inc., along with its affiliated entities, specializes in developing and bringing to market health-focused nutritional items and well-being solutions throughout the United States. Its product line encompasses diacylglycerol-based cooking oils, prominently branded as DAGola, as well as various salad oils. The company, originally established as UMeWorld Limited, is slated to officially adopt the name UMeWorld Inc. in October 2025. Incorporated in 1997, this firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Miami, Florida. Currently, UMeWorld Inc. operates as a subordinate entity within Vago International Limited's organizational structure.
